CONTENT_ORIGIN: Exact persisted115 issuance ADOPTED_CONTENT.PROPOSED_NORMATIVE_RULE, not reconstructed summary

RULE.ACCOUNTING_INTERVAL: One future exact issued probe grant and its sole attempt, from first attributable authorized publication through permanent finalization/window closure. All observer instances/restarts share one cumulative durable accounting record; no reset/refund.
RULE.BYTE_MEASURE: Composite. Retained service output/capture ceiling counts successful stream transfer under original86 rules. Observer/control-plane publication ceiling counts the canonical encoded length of every authorized logical evidence artifact/chunk admitted before publication, including raw captured copies and all headers/records, whether subsequent physical write or durability succeeds. Service-to-observer internal pipe writes are not themselves observer evidence publication; their published copies are included.

CRITICAL_EVIDENCE_RULE.CRITICAL_WRITER: Future qualified outside observer writer under separately issued evidence scope; survives workload stop within existing observer window
CRITICAL_EVIDENCE_RULE.EXHAUSTION: No silent required-event discard. Stop normal publication/scheduling, preserve consumption, attempt only preallocated critical slots; insufficient/failed critical evidence makes overall qualification INCOMPLETE. Independent verifier defaults to incomplete if final outcome is absent.
CRITICAL_EVIDENCE_RULE.FIRST_CAUSE: Immutable exact coded cause and actually preserved bounded witness; unavailable evidence explicit INCOMPLETE
CRITICAL_EVIDENCE_RULE.NORMAL_ADMISSION: Only admit normal bytes if cumulative normal precharges remain <=65536-R; all critical and normal charges combined<=65536.
CRITICAL_EVIDENCE_RULE.NORMATIVE_STATUS: Prospective rule only, not measured reserve or granted post-deadline writing
CRITICAL_EVIDENCE_RULE.RESERVE_RULE: Before any execution grant may activate, independently derive finite reserve R from exact bounded schemas, feasible event counts, actual witnesses and finalization path; include R within65536. No number/percentage chosen here.

DUPLICATE_AUDIT_RULE.AFTER_FINALIZATION: No new grant-scope publications or new attempt. Any separate host/global audit needs separate exact authority and budget, not implicitly created here. Final audit is interval-scoped.
DUPLICATE_AUDIT_RULE.COUNT_POLICY: No fixed numerical denial maximum inferred from one launch; future entry subject must derive finite record/witness admissions from allotted bytes and exact schema/controller bounds. Failure to derive blocks activation.
DUPLICATE_AUDIT_RULE.DOMAIN: All duplicate-denial evidence attributable to the grant and observed within its exact authorized collection interval is within same65536 publication allocation
DUPLICATE_AUDIT_RULE.FURTHER_REQUESTS: Continue fail-closed rejection; no new per-request publications after audit gate closes. Subsequent unrecorded requests cannot be represented as fully audited.
DUPLICATE_AUDIT_RULE.OVERFLOW_RULE: When a denial cannot be recorded with its required witness under allocated bytes/cardinality, reject request before any launch and latch INCOMPLETE_AUDIT. Publish only the pre-reserved bounded overflow/final-outcome slot, never an unlimited per-request log.
DUPLICATE_AUDIT_RULE.POLICY: Reject duplicate/partial/conflicting grant anchors without launching. Denial publication uses bounded full records with required witnesses. A bounded summary may report overflow or missing detailed denial witnesses only with INCOMPLETE_AUDIT; it does not count as complete individual causal replay and cannot make qualification PASS under this rule.

RULE.EXHAUSTION_POLICY: Pre-write admission denies any publication exceeding applicable ordinary/reserve or cumulative charge. Stop normal workload/output on denial, finalize only within independently derived reserved controls and existing observer deadline. If required evidence cannot be preserved, qualification INCOMPLETE and no retry. No larger budget/domain inferred.
RULE.FINAL_AUDIT_RULE: Final audit and no-retry status are counted in the same cap/reserve. Audit outcome must be PASS/FAIL/INCOMPLETE according to independently preserved required witnesses. Missing/unwritten/undurable final audit is INCOMPLETE, never success. Finalization cannot reopen launch authority.
RULE.INDEPENDENT_VERIFICATION: Before active entry verify exact all-producer paths and writer mediation, canonical encoding lengths, immutable precharges, reserve bound/ownership, failure/partial/duplicate ledger behavior and independent durability/exit/audit witnesses. Any bypass or unknown denies activation. This decision establishes normative rules only, not implemented enforcement.
RULE.INTERNAL_OS_BOOKKEEPING_RULE: Original86 permits system-manager transient/cgroup/private-tmp/telemetry bookkeeping. Those internal OS effects are not observer evidence publication; actual observer exports/copies from them count in the same publication allocation. This creates no unbounded OS-resource exemption or permission: separately verified host/workload controls remain mandatory. Full H77/inert-campaign cumulative-write requirements are not amended by this metadata-specific rule.
RULE.PARTIAL_WRITE_RULE: Precharge full admitted artifact/chunk once. Positive short-write suffix continuation uses the same charge; a new write/copy/republication of the same logical artifact is charged again. No overwrite/delete refund. Log API submitted and successful transfer quantities as separate bounded observations when required, and never infer persistence from transfer.

OPERATIONS: Observer pipe/FD close and timeout accounting
SECONDARY_FAILURE_RULE.POLICY: Independently derive exact operation/handle/concurrency event counts before active entry; include all simultaneously feasible secondaries in reserve. Mutually exclusive primary outcomes are not summed as concurrent.
SECONDARY_FAILURE_RULE.REPEATED_WRITES: Every new record/republication charges full logical length again; suffix continuation of same admitted artifact is not a new record. No automatic probe retry or new audit campaign.
SECONDARY_FAILURE_RULE.UNEXPECTED_OR_OVERFLOW: Additional unmodelled/missing secondary witness makes outcome INCOMPLETE; record bounded overflow via reserved slot if possible. Never claim complete errors from truncated/unverifiable exception text.
